post.description: Public registration (RF-01). Only emails from the allowed UAL domains, with phone and acceptance of the rules and privacy policy. Nothing is created yet: the data waits as a pending registration and a 6-digit code is sent to the email. The account is created, without profiles, when the email is verified (POST /api/auth/verify-email). Registering again with the same email replaces the pending registration.
post.summary: Start a registration

post.description: Checks the 6-digit code sent by email when registering (valid for 15 minutes). If it is right, the email is verified and a session is opened. After 3 wrong attempts the code is cancelled and a new one must be requested.
post.summary: Verify the email with the code and log in

post.description: Sends a new code and cancels the previous one, at most once a minute. Always answers 202, so it does not reveal which emails are registered.
post.summary: Send a new verification code

post.description: Opens a new session (RF-02): returns an access token (15 min) and a refresh token (7 days, at most 30 days since login). Only users with a verified email can log in. After 5 failed logins in a row with the same email, it is locked for 5 minutes, even with the right password.
post.summary: Log in

post.description: Exchanges the refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token. Each refresh token works once: reusing it closes the session. Clients must not send two refreshes at the same time.
post.summary: Renew the session

post.description: Closes the session of this device. Does not require the access token, and also answers 204 for an unknown refresh token.
post.summary: Log out

post.description: Sends a 6-digit code (valid for 15 minutes) to the email if it has an account, at most once a minute; also used to resend it. Always answers 202, so it does not reveal which emails are registered.
post.summary: Send a password reset code

post.description: Checks the code without using it up, so it must be sent again to set the new password. Wrong codes count as attempts: after 3 the code is cancelled and a new one must be requested.
post.summary: Check a password reset code

post.description: Uses up the code, sets the new password (it must be different from the current one) and closes every open session of the user (or every other session when refreshToken is provided).
post.summary: Set a new password with the code

post.description: Sends a 6-digit verification code by SMS to the phone number saved on my account (valid for 15 minutes, at most one code per minute). Requires having a phone number saved first (PATCH /api/users/me).
post.summary: Send a 6-digit SMS code to verify my phone number

post.description: Checks the 6-digit SMS code (up to 3 attempts, 15 minutes TTL), marks the phone as verified, records user.phone_verified without the phone number and returns the updated User resource.
post.summary: Verify my phone number with the 6-digit SMS code

post.description: Sends a 6-digit confirmation code by email to the authenticated user (purpose account_deletion, valid for 15 minutes, at most one code per minute). Fails first if the user has trips in progress or pending (ACCOUNT_HAS_ACTIVE_TRIPS).
post.summary: Send a 6-digit email code to delete my account

post.description: Checks if the 6-digit email code is valid for account deletion without consuming it.
post.summary: Verify a 6-digit email code for account deletion without deleting

post.description: In a single transaction: blocks with 409 ACCOUNT_HAS_ACTIVE_TRIPS if the user has unfinished trips as driver or accepted seats as passenger; cancels pending seat requests (notifying drivers); marks the account as deactivated (deactivated_at); revokes all refresh tokens; records the revocation of every granted consent (source account_deletion) and records user.deactivated.

post.description: RF-04. The driver must be ready (RF-21): responsible declaration accepted and at least one active vehicle. The departure must be at least one hour away, and publishing is suspended for 7 days after 3 late cancellations in 30 days. The trip cannot overlap another active trip of the driver (departure to arrival plus the maximum detour), and a driver can have at most 4 trips that are not cancelled on the same day. With returnTrip, the return trip is published in the same transaction, with the same rules (it cannot overlap the outbound trip either): both or none.

info.description: API REST del core-api (TFM, Universidad de Almería). Sigue TMF630: recursos con @type, errores con el objeto Error (códigos en docs/api/errors.md) y cabecera X-Request-Id en todas las respuestas.

message.example: The email ana@ual.es is already registered

firstName.description: Given name, the only one other users see. Letters, with a space, hyphen or apostrophe between them

lastName.description: Surnames (one, two or compound), seen only by the user and the administration. Same rules as firstName

email.description: Only emails from the allowed domains (ual.es, inlumine.ual.es)

phone.description: International format with country code; spaces, dashes and parentheses are ignored

acceptedTerms.description: Acceptance of the community rules and privacy policy

averageRating.description: Average rating (1–5) when the user has at least 3 published reviews in this role; null otherwise ("New driver" / "New passenger")

ratingCount.description: Number of published reviews received in this role

phone.description: International format (E.164); null if never registered

phoneVerified.description: Whether the current phone number has been verified by SMS (false if unverified or if the user has no phone)

isAccessRevoked.description: True when the user has profiles and an administrator has deactivated all of them

activeMode.description: The mode the user travels with now, the same on every device; null until chosen

timeToleranceMin.description: Default time margin of my searches, in minutes (± around the time)

avatarKey.description: Chosen avatar from the platform catalogue; null shows initials

bio.description: Public "About me" (20–200 characters when filled); null if empty
bio.example: Conductora habitual desde Roquetas de Mar al campus de La Cañada.

accessToken.description: JWT to send as Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>

expiresIn.description: Lifetime of the access token in seconds

refreshToken.description: Send it only to /api/auth/refresh and /api/auth/logout. Single use: each refresh returns a new one

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: The session can be renewed until this moment

refreshToken.description: The refreshToken returned by login or by the last refresh
Refresh token of the current session to keep alive while revoking every other open session

preferences.description: Travel preferences as driver and passenger

vehicleId.description: The vehicle of a vehicle declaration; null in the others

source.description: Where it was recorded: settings (the profile switch), location_prompt (the window explaining why location is used) or device (the app detected the system permission was removed)

version.description: When granting, the version of the location document that was read (the current one if omitted)

isActive.description: Activate or deactivate the profile. For the admin profile, true assigns it and false removes it

plate.description: Spanish plates: current (1234BCD) or old provincial (AL1234AB) format; other countries: 2 to 10 letters and digits with at least one digit. Spaces and hyphens are ignored

plateCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 code of the plate country: EU, EEA or Switzerland. Cannot be changed later

capacity.description: Seats for passengers, not counting the driver

plateCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 code of the plate country

brand.description: Vehicle make; null for vehicles registered before this field existed

model.description: Vehicle model; null for vehicles registered before this field existed

color.description: Key of the vehicle color catalog

changeType.description: major raises the major version (1.4 → 2.0) and asks every user to accept it again; minor raises the minor one (1.4 → 1.5)

imageHref.description: Link to the uploaded PNG or WebP image; null for an SVG

type.description: request_received (to the driver), request_accepted, request_rejected, request_conflict_cancelled and trip_cancelled (to the passenger), request_cancelled and passenger_left (to the driver), trip_started (to the accepted passengers), review_requested (to the driver and accepted passengers when the trip finishes), incident_reported (to the administrators), terms_updated and privacy_updated (to every active user after a minor change of a legal document)

trip.description: The trip; null in terms_updated and privacy_updated

legalDocument.description: The published version (its href is the current document of that type); only in terms_updated and privacy_updated

request.description: The seat request; null in incident_reported and in review_requested for the driver

token.description: The Firebase installation id (FID) on the web, or the Firebase Cloud Messaging registration token in the Android app

departureAt.description: When the driver leaves for the return trip
When the driver leaves. Send it or arrivalAt, not both

arrivalAt.description: Latest arrival at the destination (e.g. to the campus). The departure is computed from the route and the maximum detour, so the driver arrives on time even after picking someone up. Send it or departureAt, not both

offeredSeats.description: Seats offered to passengers (at most the vehicle capacity)

maxDetourMin.description: Detour budget of the whole trip, in minutes: the detours and stops (2 min each) of every accepted passenger

pickupMode.description: How the driver picks up: on the route, up to maxDetourM, or at the stops (only towards the campus)

stops.description: With pickupMode stops: the stops on the way to the campus, in any order (they are ordered along the route)

maxDetourM.description: Metres the driver goes off the route to pick up (only on the route)

returnTrip.description: Also publish the return trip (origin and destination swapped, same vehicle and detour, picking up on the route). Both trips are published or none: RETURN_TRIP_REJECTED says the return breaks a rule

originName.description: Name of the origin as chosen when publishing

destinationName.description: Name of the destination as chosen when publishing

rating.description: Average rating, available after at least three published reviews

color.description: Key of the vehicle color catalog

estimatedAt.description: When the driver gets there, after the earlier stops where someone boards

maxDetourMin.description: Detour budget of the whole trip, in minutes: the detours and stops (2 min each) of every accepted passenger fit in it

pickupMode.description: How the driver picks up: on_route (goes up to maxDetourM off the route to the passenger point) or stops (at the stops on the route)

maxDetourM.description: Metres the driver goes off the route to pick up (on_route); null with stops

stops.description: The stops, in order along the route (pickupMode stops); empty on the route. Public places: always exact

originName.description: Name of the origin as chosen when publishing

destinationName.description: Name of the destination as chosen when publishing

startedAt.description: When the trip started; null until then

isLocationApproximate.description: True when origin and destination are rounded to about 500 m (campus parkings excepted): whoever is not the driver, an accepted passenger or an administrator does not see the exact points

returnTrip.description: The return trip published with it, or null

maxDetourMin.description: Detour budget of the whole trip, in minutes: the detours and stops (2 min each) of every accepted passenger fit in it

pickupMode.description: How the driver picks up: on_route (goes up to maxDetourM off the route to the passenger point) or stops (at the stops on the route)

maxDetourM.description: Metres the driver goes off the route to pick up (on_route); null with stops

stops.description: The stops, in order along the route (pickupMode stops); empty on the route. Public places: always exact

originName.description: Name of the origin as chosen when publishing

destinationName.description: Name of the destination as chosen when publishing

startedAt.description: When the trip started; null until then

isLocationApproximate.description: True when origin and destination are rounded to about 500 m (campus parkings excepted): whoever is not the driver, an accepted passenger or an administrator does not see the exact points

geometry.description: The road route; null for whoever is not the driver, an accepted passenger or an administrator (it would show where the driver starts or ends)

source.description: osrm: the road route; estimated: a straight-line estimate, used when OSRM did not answer

estimatedArrivalAt.description: Start (or departure, if it has not started) plus the route duration; null once finished or cancelled

via.description: Stops to go through, in any order: they are ordered along the route, as when publishing

lateCancellations.description: Late cancellations in the last 30 days (with accepted passengers, less than 30 minutes before departure)

publishingSuspendedUntil.description: Until when the driver cannot publish (3 late cancellations in 30 days: 7 days from the last one), or null

departureAt.description: When the driver leaves. Send it or arrivalAt, not both

offeredSeats.description: Seats offered to passengers (at most the vehicle capacity)

maxDetourMin.description: Detour budget of the whole trip, in minutes: the detours and stops (2 min each) of every accepted passenger

maxDetourM.description: Metres the driver goes off the route to pick up (only on the route)

originName.description: Name of the origin as chosen when publishing

destinationName.description: Name of the destination as chosen when publishing

position.description: Where the driver is when finishing; stores the distance to the destination

isCovered.description: Whether the place is inside the service area

remainingSource.description: osrm: by road; estimated: a straight-line estimate, used when OSRM did not answer

seats.description: Seats for the passenger and their companions

pickupLocation.description: Passenger pickup point for a trip to campus (unless it picks up at stops: stopId); ignored for the return trip

pickupName.description: Label of the passenger pickup point

stopId.description: Towards the campus, on a trip that picks up at stops: the chosen stop (then pickupLocation and pickupName are not sent)

seats.description: Seats for the passenger and their companions

stopId.description: The stop where the passenger boards, on a trip that picks up at stops (pickupLocation and pickupName are the stop ones); null otherwise

pickupAt.description: Approximate pickup time estimated from the origin and pickup point

isPriority.description: RF-24: passenger affected by the cancellation of a trip in progress

answeredAt.description: When the driver accepted or rejected the request

vehiclePlate.description: Plate of the vehicle, only once the request is accepted (to recognise the car)

rejectionReason.description: Explanatory reason when rejected (trip_full, expired) or cancelled (no_show)

boardCode.description: 4-digit boarding code for pickup validation (visible to passenger)

boardedAt.description: When the passenger boarded the vehicle

lateCancellations.description: Late cancellations in the last 30 days (an accepted seat released less than 30 minutes before departure)

requestingSuspendedUntil.description: Until when the passenger cannot request seats (3 late cancellations in 30 days: 7 days from the last one), or null

code.description: Código de recogida de 4 cifras proporcionado por el pasajero

targetId.description: Recipient of the review (the driver when the author is an accepted passenger, or an accepted passenger when the author is the driver)

comment.example: Muy puntual y viaje muy agradable.
comment.description: Optional comment (up to 300 characters); empty becomes null

isPublished.description: True once both sides have reviewed or the 7-day window has closed

myRole.description: Role the current user had in this trip

expiresAt.description: End of the 7-day review window for this trip

comment.example: Muy puntual y viaje muy agradable.

distribution.description: Published reviews per star, from 5 to 1

driverName.description: Public display name of the trip driver

readByAll.description: Whether all other participants of the trip have read this message (computed for own messages)

unreadCount.description: Messages of the others after my last read

isOpen.description: True while new messages are accepted: trip confirmed or in progress, or finished less than 24 h ago

text.description: Plain text (trimmed). Send it or quickReply, not both
text.example: Estoy en la puerta del portal

quickReply.description: A quick reply; the only kind the driver can send while the trip is in progress

startedAt.description: When that administrator started the review; null if resolved before the review states existed

resolution.example: The driver was contacted and the car was repaired

code.description: Short code to cite the incident (consecutive number)

source.description: trip: reported while cancelling a trip in progress; chat: a report of the trip chat

isViewerInvolved.description: True when the administrator asking is involved in the trip (reported it, drives it or requested a seat): another administrator must manage it

reviewInProgress.description: Who is reviewing it (CU-12); null unless in_review

review.description: The review of the administrator (CU-12); null while open

category.description: technical problem, with the driver, with a passenger, safety or other

description.example: The car broke down on the way to the campus

resolution.example: The driver was contacted and the car was repaired

message.example: El conductor no ha llegado al punto de recogida y no responde.

place.description: Address outside the campus: where to be picked up (to campus) or dropped off (from campus)

desiredAt.description: Desired time: arrival at the campus (to campus) or departure from it (from campus)

marginMin.description: Accepted difference with the desired time, in minutes

id.description: Send it as stopId to request a seat

walkingDistanceM.description: Metres from the searched place to the stop, in a straight line

arrivalAt.description: Arrival with the detour to pick up or drop off the passenger

detourMin.description: Detour of the whole trip with this passenger, in minutes: towards the campus, the detours and stops (2 min each) of every accepted passenger and this one; from the campus, dropping this passenger off

pickupAt.description: Estimated pickup time towards the campus, after the earlier pickups and their stops; null from the campus (everybody boards there)

stop.description: Towards the campus, when the driver picks up at stops: the nearest stop (the pickup is there, at pickupAt); null otherwise

timeDifferenceMin.description: Difference with the desired time in minutes (negative: earlier)

drivers.description: Active users with the driver profile

passengers.description: Active users with the passenger profile

passengersOnBoard.description: Seats of boarded passengers in the trips in progress

isLive.description: False while replaying the events from the beginning
